applications.name: Ankh of the Necropolis IV
applications.description:
The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains {1} Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +{0}% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain {2}% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

applications.name: Ankh of the Necropolis IV
applications.description:
The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

applications.name: Necrotic Boon - Tempests
applications.description:
Storm (Pyramid X) has 3 cumulative phases that grant permanent additional effects in this fight.
Phase 1 - Fight Start: While both of Storm's Tempests are active, if she causes an attack to Glance she gains a personal Prowess Buff.
Phase 2 - Defender goes below 70% Health: If not already active, Storm activates her Alternate Tempest for 12 seconds whenever she activates a Special Attack.
Phase 3 - Defender goes below 40% Health: Storm's Tempests are paused for 2 seconds whenever the Attacker blocks one of Storm's attacks.

applications.name: Necrotic Boon - Parallel Dimensions
applications.description:
America Chavez has 3 cumulative phases that grant permanent additional effects in this fight.
Phase 1 - Fight Start: Whenever America Chavez is knocked down, a 12 second timer is started. If she is knocked down again while this timer is active, she activates her Negative Zone Dimension.
Phase 2 - Defender goes below 70% Health: If America Chavez activates the same Parallel Dimension twice in a row she instantly steals all of the Attacker's current Power and gains none of the power stolen.
Phase 3 - Defender goes below 40% Health: When this Power Steal occurs, America Chavez gains 50% of the power stolen.

applications.name: Necrotic Boon - Labors of Resilience
applications.description:
The Defender has 3 cumulative phases that grant permanent additional effects in this fight.
Phase 1 - Fight Start: Whenever the Attacker finishes a Special Attack, the Defender gains an indefinite Protection Passive, reducing all incoming damage by 30%. Max stacks 3. One of these Protection Passives is removed whenever the Attacker strikes the Defender with the first hit of their Heavy Attack while the Defender is not Stunned, or whenever the Attacker intercepts the Defender's first Medium or Light attack with any attack, or whenever the Attacker interrupts the Defender's Heavy Attack with any attack other than a Heavy Attack.
Phase 2 - Defender goes below 70% Health: The Defender now gains a Protection passive whenever they finish a Special Attack as well.

applications.name: Ankh of the Necropolis IV
applications.description:
The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

applications.name: Necrotic Boon - Ablative Shield
applications.description:
Red Guardian has 3 cumulative phases that grant permanent additional effects in this fight.
Phase 1 - Fight Start: Red Guardian loses 1 Durability in his Ablative Shield each time he is Struck by any Attack except a Heavy Attack.
Phase 2 - Defender goes below 70% Health: When Red Guardian's Shield becomes Fractured, the cooldown is always 8 seconds. If already active, the Shield's cooldown is set to 8 seconds upon entering this phase.
Phase 3 - Defender goes below 40% Health: Every 12 seconds both Champions gain an Unblockable Passive for 4 seconds.

applications.name: Ankh of the Necropolis IV
applications.description:
The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

applications.name: Ankh of the Necropolis IV
applications.description:
The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

applications.name: Ankh of the Necropolis IV
applications.description:
The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

applications.name: Ankh of the Necropolis IV
applications.description:
The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

applications.description: Whenever the Attacker blocks an attack they gain 5% of a Bar of Power. At the start of the fight the Defender activates a timer of 12 seconds and randomly selects Heavy Attack, Special Attack or Block an Attack. This timer is paused during Special Attacks and while either champion is charging or performing a Heavy Attack. If the selected action is not performed before the timer expires, all of the Attacker's Buffs are removed and they are dealt a burst of Direct Damage equal to 15% of their max Health. If the selected action is performed, the Defender selects a new action and restarts the timer. Action selections that have been successfully performed will not repeat until all actions have been successfully performed.

applications.name: Ankh of the Necropolis IV
applications.description:
The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

applications.name: Ankh of the Necropolis IV
applications.description:
The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

applications.name: Necrotic Boon - Solar Flare
applications.description: Sunspot is now Immune to all Shock effects. Whenever Sunspot is struck by a Critical Hit or activates Special Attack 1 he loses 5 Solar Charges and whenever he activates Special Attack 2 he loses 15. When Sunspot reaches 0 Solar Charges he enters Solar Flare mode, lasting for 20 seconds and granting him 80 Solar Charges when it ends. While in Solar Flare mode, whenever the Attacker makes contact with Sunspot they are inflicted with a 0% [k=glossary/nova_flame]Nova Flame[/k] Passive for 20 seconds, reducing Block Proficiency by 100%, inflicting Power Sting and reducing Solar Flare modes duration by 1 second. An Opponent with Power Sting takes 40% of the Defender's Attack as Direct Damage when they activate a Special Attack.

This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

applications.name: Ankh of the Necropolis IV
applications.description:
The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

applications.name: Necrotic Boon - Toxic Aura
applications.description: Whenever the Attacker is Immune to one of Immortal Abomination's Poison Debuffs, Immortal Abomination is inflicted with one of his personal Poison Debuffs. Poison Debuffs inflicted by Toxic Aura do not trigger this effect. Whenever Immortal Abomination would inflict himself with a Poison Debuff while he is already inflicted with 12 or more Poison Debuffs, the Attacker is inflicted with an Acid Burn Passive dealing 25% of the Defender's Attack as Direct Damage over 5 seconds.

applications.name: Ankh of the Necropolis IV
applications.description:
The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

applications.name: Necrotic Boon - Soul Capture
applications.description: Purgatory has permanent access to all of her Class Soul Abilities against all Classes. The Mystic Soul now Regenerates her due to Blocked Hits dealt to either Champion, and the Skill Soul now also inflicts a 50% [k=glossary/disorient]Disorient[/k] Passive for 9 seconds and triggers when either Champion has a Damage Over Time Debuff expire, be Purified or fail due to an Immunity. Whenever either Champion activates a Special Attack Purgatory gains 10 Bloodthirst, and Demonic Rampage is now paused during either Champion's Special Attacks.

applications.name: Necrotic Boon - Hunting Trap
applications.description: The last hit of Kraven's Special Attack 2 places a Trap at the Attacker's location that arms after 2 seconds and lasts until triggered. New Traps replace existing ones. This Trap can exist at the same time as his Special Attack 1 Trap. Whenever one of Kraven's Traps arms, he gains a Hunter Charge. When Kraven gains 3 Hunter Charges, all Charges are consumed and the Attacker is dealt a burst of Direct Damage equal to 15% of their max Health. Whenever one of Kraven's Traps activates or is prevented due to a Special Attack, he loses a Hunter Charge.

applications.name: Ankh of the Necropolis IV
applications.description:
The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

applications.name: Necrotic Boon - Death Touch
applications.description: The Attacker is Immune to Bleed, Poison and Incinerate Debuffs. Black Widow (Claire Voyant) cycles between her three Curses every 6 seconds in order. When she changes Curses, the Attacker gains 3 indefinite Placebo Buffs. While Black Widow has 0 Clairvoyance Charges or 20 Clairvoyance Charges she gains Death Touch for 8 seconds. While Death Touch is active Black Widow is Passively Unblockable and her successful hits instantly knockout the Attacker. When Death Touch ends, all Clairvoyance Charge are removed and Black Widow cannot enter Death Touch in this way for 15 seconds.

applications.name: Ankh of the Necropolis IV
applications.description:
The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

applications.name: Necrotic Boon - Taa'an Biology
applications.description:
The Defender has 3 cumulative phases that grant permanent additional effects in this fight.
Phase 1 - Fight Start: Every 12 seconds the Attacker is inflicted with a [k=glossary/special_lock]Special Lock[/k] Passive for 4 seconds. If the Attacker is far away from the Defender when this triggers, the Defender is Special Locked instead.
Phase 2 - Defender goes below 70% Health: Striking the Defender's Block grants the Defender a 50% [k=glossary/prowess]Prowess[/k] Buff for 10 seconds.
Phase 3 - Defender goes below 40% Health: The Defender's Buffs now have their Ability Accuracy increased by +50%.

The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

applications.name: Necrotic Boon - Alchemical Ingredients
applications.description:
The Defender has 3 cumulative phases that grant permanent additional effects in this fight.
Phase 1 - Fight Start: At the start of the fight and every 18 seconds, the Defender picks 1 of 3 Alchemical Ingredients. When the Attacker throws a Light Attack it rotates the Attacker's dormant Alchemical Ingredient from Emberboon to Lifestitch and then Ironskin before repeating. Performing a Medium Combo Ender brews the dormant Alchemical Ingredient, replacing any existing one. A brewed Alchemical Ingredient can be consumed by dashing back and holding Block for 0.6 seconds. If the Alchemical Ingredient picked by the Defender is not consumed by the Attacker before the next one triggers, the Attacker is dealt a burst of Direct Damage equal to 15% of their max Health.
Phase 2 - Defender goes below 70% Health: Consuming Alchemical Ingredients now requires the Attacker to dash back and hold Block for 1.2 seconds.
Phase 3 - Defender goes below 40% Health: Alchemical Ingredients now take 3 seconds to brew before they can be consumed.

applications.name: Ankh of the Necropolis IV
applications.description:
The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

applications.name: Necrotic Boon - Terminal Velocity
applications.description:
Quicksilver has 3 cumulative phases that grant permanent additional effects in this fight.
Phase 1 - Fight Start: The Attacker's True Strike and True Accuracy abilities suffer -100% Ability Accuracy.
Phase 2 - Defender goes below 70% Health: Whenever Quicksilver activates a Special Attack he gains 50 Momentum Charges, unaffected by his Heavy modifier.
Phase 3 - Defender goes below 40% Health: Every 10 seconds Quicksilver gains 100 Momentum Charges, unaffected by his Heavy modifier. Intercepting the Defender resets this timer.

applications.name: Necrotic Boon - Adaptive Protocols
applications.description:
Nimrod has 3 cumulative phases that grant permanent additional effects in this fight.
Phase 1 - Fight Start: Whenever Nimrod is knocked down, he gains a Protocol Charge.
Phase 2 - Defender goes below 70% Health: When Nimrod would gain a Protocol Charge while he has 10, he immediately enters Eradicate Protocol. When Nimrod enters Eradicate Protocol he becomes passively Debuff Immune for 3 seconds.
Phase 3 - Defender goes below 40% Health: Nimrod's Special Lock lasts for an extra 0.25 seconds for each Protocol Charge he has.

applications.name: Necrotic Boon - Black Vortex
applications.description:
Kitty Pryde has 3 cumulative phases that grant permanent additional effects in this fight.
Phase 1 - Fight Start: Kitty Pryde is Immune to all Cowardice effects. Whenever a Prowess effect is removed from her due to one of the Attacker's abilities, she gains one of her personal Prowess Passives.
Phase 2 - Defender goes below 70% Health: Every 10th Hit in the Attacker's Combo Meter must be due to a Light Attack or Kitty gains a 100% Damage Over Time Resistance Passive for 7 seconds.
Phase 3 - Defender goes below 40% Health: Blocking any hit of Kitty's Special Attack 1 grants her 2 Bars of Power that are unaffected by Ability Power modification, a 6 second [k=glossary/taunt]Taunt[/k] Passive, and 8 of her personal Prowess Passives at the end of that Special Attack. applications.name: Necrotic Boon - Wushu Strikes
applications.description:
Shang-Chi has 3 cumulative phases that grant permanent additional effects in this fight.
Phase 1 - Fight Start: Shang-Chi performs his Wushu Strikes when the Attacker performs the corresponding combos as though he had performed the combos himself. Whenever the Attacker lands a Heavy Attack, all Unreadied Wushu Strikes are Readied. Whenever Shang-Chi finishes his Special Attack 1 he loses 1 Chi Charge. If Shang-Chi activates a Special Attack while he has no Chi Charges, the Attacker is dealt a burst of Direct Damage equal to 15% of their max Health.
Phase 2 - Defender goes below 70% Health: If the Attacker lands a combo that would trigger one of Shang-Chi's Unreadied Wushu Strikes, the Attacker is dealt a burst of Direct Damage equal to 15% of their max Health.
Phase 3 - Defender goes below 40% Health: The Attacker's Heavy Attacks no longer Ready Wushu Strikes. Instead, when all Wushu Strikes become Unreadied, all Stun effects on the Attacker are removed and all Wushu Strikes become Readied.

applications.name: Ankh of the Necropolis IV
applications.description:
The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains {1} Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +{0}% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain {2}% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.

applications.name: Necrotic Boon - Tippy-Toe
applications.description: If the Attacker has the Willpower Mastery active, it is removed. Every 22 seconds Tippy-Toe attaches to the Attacker for 15 seconds, inflicting an instant 25% [k=glossary/rupture]Rupture[/k] for each Rupture Debuff that was on the Attacker, removing all Rupture Debuffs. While Tippy is attached to the Attacker, their Block Proficiency is increased by 10000 and they are inflicted with a Rupture Debuff every second, dealing 1% of the Defender's Attack as Direct Damage over 15 seconds. Whenever the Attacker would strike Squirrel Girl with a Heavy Attack while she is Stunned, she gains an [k=glossary/unstoppable]Unstoppable[/k] Passive for 2 seconds.
applications.rawDescription: If the Attacker has the Willpower Mastery active, it is removed. While Tippy is attached to the Attacker, their Block Proficiency is increased by 10000 and they are inflicted with a Rupture Debuff every second, dealing 1% of the Defender's Attack as Direct Damage over {0} seconds. Whenever the Attacker would strike Squirrel Girl with a Heavy Attack while she is Stunned, she gains an [k=glossary/unstoppable]Unstoppable[/k] Passive for {3} seconds.
